maddeler.e:
انحرقت (form VII)
# اِنْحَرَقْتُ (inḥaraqtu) /in.ħa.raq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَرَقَ (inḥaraqa)
# اِنْحَرَقْتَ (inḥaraqta) /in.ħa.raq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَرَقَ (inḥaraqa)
# اِنْحَرَقْتِ (inḥaraqti) /in.ħa.raq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَرَقَ (inḥaraqa)
# اِنْحَرَقَتْ (inḥaraqat) /in.ħa.ra.qat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
